partners.mechanism_chain: PRKAR1A (HGNC:9340) —DISRUPTS→ cAMP-PKA signaling pathway (R-HSA-1280307); cAMP-PKA signaling pathway (R-HSA-1280307) —LEADS_TO→ Adrenal cortical hyperplasia (HP:0011031); CALM1 (HGNC:1702) —DISRUPTS→ Cardiac ion channel regulation (R-HSA-168872); Cardiac ion channel regulation (R-HSA-168872) —LEADS_TO→ QT prolongation (HP:0011678); cAMP-PKA signaling pathway (R-HSA-1280307) —BINDS→ Cardiac ion channel regulation (R-HSA-168872). Mutations in PRKAR1A (a regulatory subunit of Protein Kinase A) lead to loss of feedback inhibition on PKA, causing constitutive activation of the cAMP-PKA signaling pathway, resulting in adrenal hyperplasia (PPNAD1). Concurrently, mutations in CALM1, which encodes calmodulin, a critical calcium-binding protein that regulates cardiac ion channels, can lead to altered calcium channel function and QT prolongation (LQT14).
